title: Intel Corporation Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 27, 2026
excerpt: Second-quarter net revenue was $16.128 billion, gross profit was $6.509 billion, operating income was $1.796 billion, and six-month operating cash flow was $8.102 billion.
summary: The unchanged filing remains the authoritative operating baseline: year-over-year quarterly revenue and gross profit improved and operating income turned positive, while foundry loss, capital intensity, debt and the non-cash equity-accounting loss remain central risks.
